result.summary: The pedestrian environment features narrow residential streets with sidewalks that are in poor condition, showing significant cracking, weeds, and debris. While a stop sign and faded crosswalk markings are present, the lack of ADA-compliant curb ramps and poor pavement quality create accessibility and safety challenges.

hazards.name: Poor Sidewalk Condition
hazards.description: Cracked, uneven pavement with weeds and debris creates tripping hazards and limits mobility.

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: No sloped transition for wheelchairs or strollers at the intersection corner.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Resurface the sidewalk to remove cracks and vegetation, ensuring a level and safe walking surface.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramp Installation
interventions.description: Install tactile, sloped curb ramps at the corner to provide universal accessibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk using continental or ladder patterns to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the corner to improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection that lacks fundamental pedestrian safety infrastructure, including marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps. Parked vehicles along the curbs create significant visual obstructions, reducing visibility between pedestrians and drivers at the crossing points.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: No designated pedestrian crossing areas are provided, leaving pedestrians to cross in an uncontrolled environment.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corners block sightlines for both pedestrians and motorists.

hazards.name: Absence of curb ramps
hazards.description: The lack of sloped transitions at the corners creates a physical barrier for people with mobility impairments or strollers.
